rule_lock.sequence: Locked after inspecting original and first diagnostic set, before selecting second diagnostic set.
rule_lock.limits: First diagnostic set is now development data; use only the second additional set to assess newly encountered examples for v3.

limitations: v3 used original and first diagnostic findings; neither is now unseen.
Second diagnostic is a small same-collection/assistant set; source boilerplate overlaps and labels still need user adjudication.
No clinical correctness, independent benchmark or natural-language answering performance claim.
decision: v3 is the preferred experimental relevance revision on observed results; v1/v2 are preserved. Remaining errors and non-independent evaluation prevent a readiness claim.
